difficulty.definition: Contact geometry only; no Shot Power, hold or speed dependency

hysteresis.rule: retain previous only while eligible and within score margin of best; no expanded exit corridor

targetAssistance.rangeIntentRule: Receiver lock uses existing moving-receiver lead and pace. Manual uses a stationary point.
